New:
- Zipped layers are now backed up. Layers that QGIS reads from inside an archive (`/vsizip/`, and likewise `.tar`, `.7z`, `.rar`, `.gz`) have their archive copied into `layers/`, and the layer points to the copy. Both QGIS path forms are handled, including `/vsizip/{archive.zip}/...` and provider suffixes such as `|layername=...`
- An archive that is itself a layer is copied even when the skip list contains an extension-only pattern such as `*.zip`. Named patterns (for example `*ortofoto*.*`) still skip it, and patterns are also matched against the layer inside the archive

Fixes:
- Remote GDAL paths such as `/vsicurl/`, `/vsis3/` and `/vsimem/` are left unchanged instead of being reported as missing files
